title: Spicy Chicken Skillet
description: A quick and flavorful chicken skillet dish with a spicy kick.

ingredients.name: skillet
ingredients.notes: any size will do, but larger is better

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the spicy sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chicken back into the skillet and sprinkle with Dutch spice blend, salt, and pepper.
Stir to combine and continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes.
